lines.en: label christmalloween1:
scene makotoxmasangy1
: Have you all gone mad?! {i}Christmalloween?!{/i} So we’re just making up holidays now?! Is that what this world has come to?!
lines.zh: : 你们都疯了吗?! {i}圣诞万圣节?!{/i} 所以我们现在干脆开始自己编节日了?! 这个世界已经变成这样了吗?!

lines.en: : What’s gotten into Makoto? Since when does anybody have a problem with Christmalloween? This is the one day of the year everyone is supposed to come together and celebrate the birth of candy.
lines.zh: : Makoto 这是怎么了？什么时候开始有人对圣诞万圣节有意见了？这是一年里唯一一天，所有人都该聚到一起，庆祝糖果的诞生的。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy2
: The {i}birth{/i} of candy?! That’s not a thing! You’re combining two different holidays! There’s Christmas and there’s Halloween! Pick one!
lines.zh: : 糖果的{i}诞生{/i}?! 根本没这回事!你们是把两个不同的节日混在一起!有圣诞节，还有万圣节!选一个!

lines.en: : You better be careful Makoto. At this rate, Santa’s going to hop off his skeletal reindeer just to put your ass in the naughty grimoire. Then it’s nothing but bones for you until next year.
lines.zh: : 你最好小心点，Makoto。再这样下去，圣诞老人会从他的骷髅驯鹿上跳下来，就为了把你的名字记进淘气魔法书。然后到明年之前，你除了骨头什么都别想拿到。

lines.en: : Is there a fucking gas leak in here or something?! What is happening?!
lines.zh: : 这里他妈的是不是煤气泄漏了还是怎么的?! 到底在搞什么?!

lines.en: : Beats me. But you’re being a real Ichabod Scrooge right now.
lines.zh: : 我哪知道。不过你现在可真是个 Ichabod Scrooge。

lines.en: : I hope no one’s spiked the pumpkin nog...I already had some. And I can’t think of any other reason Makoto would flip on her Christmalloween stance other than being drunk.
lines.zh: : 希望没人往南瓜蛋奶酒里掺酒……我已经喝了几口。而且除了喝醉，我真想不出 Makoto 会突然在圣诞万圣节立场上翻脸的其他理由。

lines.en: : Yeah, Makoto! What friggin’ gives?
lines.zh: : 就是啊，Makoto!到底怎么回事?!

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy3
: You {i}love{/i} Christmalloween. You make me help ya find a dead tree to decorate with candy wrappers every single year. The heck happened?
lines.zh: : 你{i}最爱{/i}圣诞万圣节了。每年你都拉着我帮你找一棵枯树，用糖纸来装饰它。到底出什么事了?

lines.en: : It’s gotta be the imbalance. Makoto clearly cares more about the “Christ” part of “Christmalloween” than the “Malloween” part and Malloween costumes are trending right now.
lines.zh: : 肯定是失衡了。Makoto 显然更在意「圣诞万圣节」里的「圣诞」，而不是「万圣」，可眼下流行的偏偏是万圣节服装。

lines.en: : There {i}is{/i} no Malloween! It’s {i}Halloween!{/i} And Christmas!
lines.zh: : 根本{i}没有{/i}什么万圣!那是{i}万圣节!{/i}还有圣诞节!

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy4
: Chill, girl. If you want to go change, nobody will hold it against you. And Sana’s got enough costume to go around. Just take some of hers.
lines.zh: : 冷静点，姑娘。如果你想去换衣服，没人会怪你。而且 Sana 那身衣服料子多得是，分你点就是了。

lines.en: : I want...to keep the claws, though...I feel like they...might come in handy...
lines.zh: : 可是我……想留着爪子……我觉得它们……可能派得上用场……

lines.en: : I don’t want to change! It’s all of {i}you{/i} who should change! Today’s probably not even a {i}real{/i} holiday! Someone tell me the date!
lines.zh: : 我不想换!该换的是{i}你们{/i}!今天搞不好根本不是个{i}真正的{/i}节日!谁来告诉我今天是几号!

lines.en: : It’s November 18th, Makoto. The same as {i}every{/i} Christmalloween.
lines.zh: : 今天是 11 月 18 日，Makoto。跟{i}每一年{/i}的圣诞万圣节都一样。

lines.en: : Then what the fuck is October 31st?! Or December 25th?! Huh?!
lines.zh: : 那 10 月 31 日他妈的算什么?! 还有 12 月 25 日呢?! 啊?!

lines.en: : Makoto, you’re gonna need to keep it down or you’re gonna set off Miku’s PTSD again. And she looks too cute today to be freaking out and crying.
lines.zh: : Makoto，你得小声点，不然又要勾起 Miku 的创伤后应激障碍了。而且她今天这么可爱，不该被吓到崩溃大哭。

lines.en: : I can’t help it! This is all just fucking insane! Christmalloween isn’t real! None of this is real!
lines.zh: : 我忍不住!这一切都他妈疯了!圣诞万圣节根本不存在!这些全都不是真的!

lines.en: : I’m guessing that shirt ain’t real either then?
lines.zh: : 那我猜，你身上那件衬衫也不是真的咯?

lines.en: : What shirt? I’m not-
lines.zh: : 什么衬衫？我才没有——

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy5
scene makotoxmasangy6
: FUCK!
scene makotoxmasangy7
: You know, Kirin — I’m a big fan of the new you. This is the most innocent and least revealing costume you’ve probably ever had.
lines.zh: : 说真的，Kirin——我超喜欢全新的你。这大概是你穿过的最清纯、露得最少的一套服装了。

lines.en: : At least since I was like twelve, yeah.
lines.zh: : 至少从我大概十二岁以后，是吧。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy8
: It feels kind of weird, though. I haven’t gotten in trouble yet.
lines.zh: : 不过感觉挺怪的。我到现在还没惹上麻烦呢。

lines.en: : Hell, I haven’t even hit on Imani yet and that’s basically become a Christmalloween tradition for me.
lines.zh: : 见鬼，我连 Imani 都还没勾搭过呢，而这基本已经成了我的圣诞万圣节传统了。

lines.en: : You did hit on me, though. But I’m going to assume that’s mostly just because you think I’m a wolf and read some weird sort of Little Red Riding Hood doujinshi or something.
lines.zh: : 不过你倒是勾搭了我。但我猜这主要是因为你以为我是狼，还看了什么奇怪的小红帽同人志之类的东西。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy9
: Sorry. Are you {i}not{/i} a wolf?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你{i}不是{/i}狼吗?

lines.en: : No, I’ve told you a million times. I’m a hellhound. Loona? From that show I made you watch?
lines.zh: : 不是，我跟你说过一百万遍了。我是地狱犬。Loona？就是我逼你一起看的那个动画里的？

lines.en: : The one with all the cursing and weird demon sex?
lines.zh: : 那个满嘴脏话、还有奇怪的恶魔性爱场面的?

lines.en: : Yeah, that one.
lines.zh: : 嗯，就是那个。

lines.en: : Right. Yeah, I’m still going to keep calling you a wolf. It just makes more sense and goes with my costume.
lines.zh: : 哦。行吧，我还是继续叫你狼。这样更顺口，也跟我这身衣服搭。

lines.en: : That seems very culturally insensitive to my hellhound pack and people. You’re lucky canines are prone to domestication and loyalty, otherwise I might try to change your ways.
lines.zh: : 这对我的地狱犬族群和同胞来说，可是相当的文化不敏感。算你走运，犬类天生容易被驯化又忠诚，否则我大概会想办法改改你这个毛病。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy10
: Hey, speaking of domestication and loyalty, where’s your master? I need to show him I’m not a slut anymore and hope he still likes me.
lines.zh: : 嘿，说到驯化和忠诚，你的主人呢？我得让他看看我已经不是荡妇了，希望他还喜欢我。

lines.en: : Of course he’ll still like you, Kirin. I’m not a slut and he loves {i}me.{/i}
lines.zh: : 他当然还是会喜欢你的，Kirin。我就不是荡妇，而他爱的是{i}我{/i}。

lines.en: : Sure, but you have redeeming qualities and I just need to bank on my blowjob skills carrying my entire existence.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你有别的优点，而我只能指望我的口交技术来撑起我整个人的存在价值。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy11
: You have {i}plenty{/i} of redeeming qualities, Kirin! You’re protective and kind and caring and the only reason you act up is because you’re overly sensitive and misguided.
lines.zh: : 你的优点{i}多的是{/i}，Kirin!你有保护欲、善良、会体贴人，你会闹别扭只是因为你太敏感又被人带歪了。

lines.en: : But, if we’re being real, I imagine the blowjob thing is currently higher up on Onii-chan’s quality ranking than any of those other aspects of your character.
lines.zh: : 不过说实话，我猜在 Onii-chan 的评分表上，口交那项现在的排名，大概比你性格里其他任何一项都高。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy12
: So hey, maybe he likes you even more than me. It’s not like those skills go away just because you’re wearing a costume.
lines.zh: : 所以嘛，说不定他喜欢你比喜欢我还多。那些技术又不会因为你现在穿了身衣服就消失。

lines.en: : And if I know anything about my big brother, it’s that the innocence {i}of{/i} said costume will probably just make him like you more.
lines.zh: : 而且我对我哥还有一点了解，那就是这身衣服的{i}清纯感{/i}大概只会让他更喜欢你。

lines.en: : It’s kind of sad that {i}that{/i} is the primary quality you know about him. I’m not going to argue with it if it gives me some kind of advantage, though. I need all the help I can get.
lines.zh: : 你了解他的主要特质居然是{i}这个{/i}，说起来还挺可悲的。不过要是这能让我占点便宜，我也不打算反驳。我太需要一切能帮上忙的东西了。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy13
: What’s the next move then? Are you going to try and win his heart for real tonight?
lines.zh: : 那下一步呢？你今晚打算真的去赢他的心吗?

lines.en: : I don’t know...And I feel kind of weird talking to {i}you{/i} about it when you’re after the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我不知道……而且你在追同一样东西，我跟{i}你{/i}聊这个总觉得怪怪的。

lines.en: : Sure, I get that. I just can’t keep my status as a martyr without trying to help you right now. And I’ve worked hard for that status, Little Red Riding Whore.
lines.zh: : 我懂，我明白。可我现在要是不帮你，就没法保住我这殉道者的身份了。为了这个身份我可是下了苦功的，小红帽小荡妇。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy14
: Oh, that was good. Nice one, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 哦，这句漂亮。说得好，Noriko。

lines.en: : Chika’s not here yet so somebody needs to insult you in the meantime in order for you to keep your groove.
lines.zh: : Chika 还没来，所以在她来之前，总得有人来损你，好让你保持状态。

lines.en: : Can we just have another threesome and then {i}both{/i} of us can win? It’s hard for me to be as nice as you when it comes to our rivalry now.
lines.zh: : 我们就不能再来一次三人行，然后{i}两个{/i}人都赢吗？现在一涉及到我们的竞争关系，我就没法像你这么大方。

lines.en: : I’m struggling to understand what sort of sense that would make from a character and roleplay perspective. Even {i}if{/i} we just decide on me being a wolf.
lines.zh: : 我实在想不通，从角色扮演的角度来看这有什么道理。{i}就算{/i}我们假定我是狼也一样。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy15
: Unless...Onii-chan dresses up as a wolf as well and we...group up to...dominate the girl that...
lines.zh: : 除非……Onii-chan 也扮成狼，然后我们……组队去……征服那个女生……

lines.en: : Uhh-
scene makotoxmasangy16
: Switch costumes with me. There’s something I need to do.
lines.zh: : 跟我换衣服。我有件事要做。

lines.en: : Keep your furry fantasies out of my life. I don’t want to dress up as a wolf just so you can have the experience of fucking {i}double{/i} bestiality or whatever.
lines.zh: : 把你的兽人幻想从我的生活里拿出去。我可不想为了让你体验什么{i}双重{/i}兽交就去扮狼。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy17
: But {i}I’d{/i} do it for you!
lines.zh: : 可{i}我{/i}愿意为你这么做啊!

lines.en: : I know you would! Because you’re a better person than me. And, no offense, but I kind of just care about myself right now.
lines.zh: : 我知道你会!因为你比我好。还有，别介意，但我现在只顾得上我自己。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy18
: My entire relationship with Sensei is predicated on sex and I...I want more now. I want him to {i}really{/i} like me. Not just...{i}trick{/i} himself into thinking he...you know.
lines.zh: : 我和 Sensei 的整段关系都建立在性上，而我……我现在想要更多。我想让他{i}真的{/i}喜欢我。而不是……只是{i}骗{/i}自己相信他……你知道的。

lines.en: : And I could be completely wrong here, but my instincts are telling me that if I’m going to make that happen, I need to actually connect with him on an emotional level.
lines.zh: : 也许我完全想错了，但我的直觉告诉我，要想让这件事成真，我得真正在情感层面跟他产生连接。

lines.en: : That...{i}is{/i} how most relationships are formed, yes.
lines.zh: : 这……{i}确实{/i}是大多数感情建立起来的方式，没错。

lines.en: : How the {i}fuck{/i} am I supposed to do that, though? He’s so confusing and pitiful that I just straight up don’t even know how to {i}talk{/i} to him.
lines.zh: : 可我他{i}妈{/i}到底该怎么做？他又让人摸不着头脑又可怜，我干脆连怎么跟他{i}说话{/i}都不知道。

lines.en: : You just {i}do{/i} it, Kirin. You’re making it sound way harder than it actually is.
lines.zh: : 你只管{i}去做{/i}就是了，Kirin。你把这事儿说得比实际上难多了。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy19
: Onii-chan might be a creepy pervert that your parents would never be okay with you dating. And pursuing him could possibly ruin your relationship with your sister and your best friend-
lines.zh: : Onii-chan 可能是个变态色狼，你爸妈绝对不会同意你跟他交往。而且追他可能会毁掉你和你姐姐、还有你最好的朋友之间的关系——

lines.en: : Sorry, is that actually supposed to be convincing? Or are you just subtly trying to talk me out of this right now?
lines.zh: : 不好意思，你这是在说服我吗？还是你其实在拐着弯地劝我打退堂鼓?

lines.en: : ...but what really matters after all is said and done is you.
lines.zh: : ……但到头来，真正重要的还是你。

lines.en: : You want someone you can just sit down and talk about your day with, right? Someone who will be there regardless of what you’re willing to {i}trade?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你想要的是那种能坐下来跟你聊聊今天过得怎么样的人，对吧？不管你愿意{i}付出{/i}什么，他都会在你身边的那种?

lines.en: : Then just fucking talk to him, idiot. He might be creepy, but he {i}does{/i} have the capacity of caring for someone.
lines.zh: : 那就去他妈的跟他说话啊，笨蛋。他可能是很恶心，但他{i}确实{/i}有关心别人的能力。

lines.en: : He has thoughts and feelings and wants to talk about them just as much as anybody. He just kind of sucks at it and needs somebody to hold his hand.
lines.zh: : 他有想法、有感情，也跟任何人一样想找人倾诉。他只是这方面很烂，需要有人牵着他的手。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy20
: We have to hold hands?! Isn’t it a little soon for that?!
lines.zh: : 我们还得牵手?! 现在是不是太早了点?!

lines.en: : Didn’t you guys make out in the middle of a restaurant once?
lines.zh: : 你们不是有一次在餐厅中间就亲上了吗?

lines.en: : Yeah, but we didn’t {i}hold hands!{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我们那次没有{i}牵手{/i}啊!

lines.en: : He’s literally ejaculated inside of you.
lines.zh: : 他可是真的射在你里面过。

lines.en: : What part of this “holding hands” thing are you not getting, Noriko?!
lines.zh: : 这个「牵手」到底有哪点你听不懂，Noriko?!

lines.en: : Kirin, he’ll be here any minute. And when he {i}gets{/i} here, you’ve gotta just go for it.
lines.zh: : Kirin，他随时都可能到。等他{i}一{/i}来，你就得上。

lines.en: : Don’t be like me and let everyone else step in front of you. Because I may be young, but that’s currently my greatest regret. And I love you too much to let you hurt yourself too.
lines.zh: : 别像我一样，让别人都插到你前面去。我虽然年纪小，但这是我目前最大的遗憾。而且我太爱你了，不能眼睁睁看着你也伤到自己。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy21
: Do you love me enough to practice holding hands with me?
lines.zh: : 你有多爱我，愿意跟我练习牵手吗?

lines.en: : Do I look like a prostitute to you, Kirin?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像妓女吗，Kirin?

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy22
: {i}Th-There! He’s here! What do I-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}来、来了!他来了!我该-{/i}

lines.en: : Onii-chan! Hi! Kirin wants to talk to you about something!
lines.zh: : Onii-chan!你好!Kirin 有话想跟你说!

lines.en: : {i}Noriko! Don’t just throw me under the bus like that-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Noriko!别就这么把我卖了啊-{/i}

lines.en: : Kirin is going to have to wait. I need to talk to Makoto about something.
lines.zh: : Kirin 得等一等。我有点事要跟 Makoto 谈。

lines.en: : Oh, thank fucking god. Everyone here has gone insane and I hate this fucking sweater.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。这里所有人都疯了，而且我恨死这件该死的毛衣了。

lines.en: : I bought that for you! You said you loved it!
lines.zh: : 那是我买给你的!你明明说你很喜欢!

lines.en: : Should I come too? Or-
lines.zh: : 我也一起去吗？还是——

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy23
: There’s really no need for that, is there? We trust Sensei enough to let him talk to Makoto for a few minutes without anything happening, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 真的没必要吧？我们总该信任 Sensei，让他跟 Makoto 单独谈几分钟也不会出什么事，对吧?

lines.en: : Not really, no.
lines.zh: : 不太信任，说实话。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy24
: Happy Christmalloween, Supreme Overlord! Do not let the one with two sets of eyes deceive you into believing such a joyous day does not exist.
lines.zh: : 圣诞万圣节快乐，至高霸主!别让那个长着两双眼睛的家伙骗你，让你以为这么欢乐的日子不存在。

lines.en: : Also, please do not open the green bag in the bedroom. Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
lines.zh: : 另外，请不要打开卧室里的那个绿色袋子。提前谢谢您的配合。

lines.en: : Uh...you’re welcome?
lines.zh: : 呃……不客气?

lines.en: : Could you please turn on the lights as well? Thank you in advance for your cooperation.
lines.zh: : 能麻烦您顺便把灯也打开吗？提前谢谢您的配合。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy25
: For the tenth time, just take the mask off. I won’t be offended.
lines.zh: : 我都说第十遍了，把面具摘了吧。我不会介意的。

lines.en: : No, keep it on. I like it.
lines.zh: : 不，戴着吧。我喜欢。

lines.en: : Makoto. Bedroom. Now.
lines.zh: : Makoto。卧室。现在。

lines.en: scene black
: Right here?! With all of us outside of the door?! We’ve yet to even spin a bottle!
lines.zh: : 就在这儿?! 我们全都还在门外呢?! 我们连转瓶子的游戏都还没玩!

lines.en: : {size=-1}Not a fan of how you worded that, Senpai! Also, hi. Happy Christmalloween. Please avoid looking at Rika. Her skirt is far too short and you may see something you will never be able to unsee.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-1}Senpai，你这措辞我可不喜欢!还有，嗨。圣诞万圣节快乐。请尽量避免看 Rika。她的裙子太短了，你可能会看到一辈子都忘不掉的东西。{/size}

lines.en: : I don’t mind...so long as it’s you, Akira...
lines.zh: : 我不介意……只要是你，Akira……

lines.en: : Mom! {i}Please{/i} go put something else on! Literally everyone won’t stop looking at you!
lines.zh: : 妈!{i}拜托{/i}你去换件衣服吧!真的所有人都在不停看你!

lines.en: : That’s why I’m standing next to Sana! She’s supposed to distract everyone from- ah! Akira, please! Not in front of the-
lines.zh: : 所以我才站在 Sana 旁边啊!她本来该把所有人的注意力都引开的——啊!Akira，别这样!别当着——

lines.en: : I need this room for a minute. Don’t eavesdrop.
lines.zh: : 这房间我借用一下。别偷听。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy26
: I feel like you could have and {i}should{/i} have been exponentially more subtle about this.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你本可以、也{i}本该{/i}把这事做得含蓄得多。

lines.en: : Pulling me into a room by yourself is definitely not helping your image out, Sensei. You should have let Ayane join us at the very least. {i}Regardless{/i} of what Ami had to say.
lines.zh: : 你一个人把我拉进房间，对改善你的形象可一点帮助都没有，Sensei。你至少该让 Ayane 一起来。{i}不管{/i} Ami 怎么说。

lines.en: : The last thing I want to do right now is make Ami suspicious. What do you remember? Why do you love Christmalloween?
lines.zh: : 我现在最不想做的就是让 Ami 起疑。你还记得什么？你为什么会喜欢圣诞万圣节?

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy27
: I don’t! I woke up in the middle of this blasted party and was already wearing this fucking sweater! I {i}hate{/i} Christmalloween! And I hate that everyone thinks that it’s real!
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢!我一觉醒来就在这个该死的派对中间，身上还穿着这件操蛋的毛衣!我{i}恨{/i}圣诞万圣节!我也恨所有人都觉得它是真的!

lines.en: : That’s like me and monks.
lines.zh: : 那感觉就像我和和尚。

lines.en: : Monks {i}are{/i} real! Don’t tell me {i}you’ve{/i} been brainwashed too?!
lines.zh: : 和尚{i}当然{/i}是真的!别告诉我{i}你{/i}也被洗脑了?!

lines.en: : Not the kind I’m talking about, but the point remains. Something is definitely wrong here and we need to figure out what.
lines.zh: : 我说的不是那种和尚，但重点不变。这里肯定出了什么问题，我们得弄清楚是什么。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy28
: Ayane and I both have memories of something we don’t remember experiencing. And if you’re the same way, it might actually give us some sort of lead.
lines.zh: : Ayane 和我都有一些自己根本没经历过的记忆。如果你也一样，那说不定能给我们提供某种线索。

lines.en: : Well, what kind of memories are you talking about exactly? Because all {i}I{/i} really remember is needing to create a macaroni portrait of a horse-man. And something about sticks I think?
lines.zh: : 那……你说的到底是什么记忆？因为{i}我{/i}唯一记得的，就是得用通心粉做一幅马人的肖像画。好像还跟棍子有关?

lines.en: : First, have you said {i}anything{/i} about the apocalypse to Ami?
lines.zh: : 先回答我：你有没有跟 Ami 提过{i}任何{/i}关于末日的事?

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy29
: Makoto...
lines.zh: : Makoto……

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy30
: It was right after I learned about all this stuff, okay?! I had no idea what was going on and it made sense to me to try and find out if {i}she{/i} did!
lines.zh: : 那是在我刚知道这些事的时候，好不好?! 我当时完全搞不清状况，觉得去试探{i}她{/i}知不知道也合情合理!

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy31
: It was no use, though. She just did the same thing everyone {i}else{/i} does and kept repeating the last thing she said to me. So I doubt she remembers me trying to talk to her about it at all.
lines.zh: : 不过没用。她就跟{i}其他{/i}所有人一样，一直重复她对我说的最后一句话。所以我怀疑她根本不记得我试着跟她谈过这事。

lines.en: : That’s it? She didn’t, like...freak out or anything?
lines.zh: : 就这样？她没有……比方说……崩溃之类的?

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy32
: Not at all. It was like talking to a parrot, really. A very annoying, incestuous parrot.
lines.zh: : 完全没有。说真的，就像在跟一只鹦鹉说话。一只特别烦人、还乱伦的鹦鹉。

lines.en: : Huh...okay. Well, that’s...good news? I think?
lines.zh: : 嗯……好吧。那这算……好消息？大概?

lines.en: : Was that all?
lines.zh: : 就这些?

lines.en: : No. The second involves Maya. And about how this might...be her fault in some sort of way?
lines.zh: : 不。第二件跟 Maya 有关。关于这件事……说不定是她的错，在某种程度上?

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy33
: What? How does {i}that{/i} make sense? She was literally reset, wasn’t she? Why would she do that to herself?
lines.zh: : 什么？{i}这{/i}怎么讲得通？她明明被重置过了啊，不是吗？她为什么要对自己做这种事?

lines.en: : I have no idea. And I don’t even know if it’s {i}true{/i} either. I just...felt that way once the reset ended. And while I know it’s not really a lead we can follow-
lines.zh: : 我也不知道。而且我甚至不确定这是不是{i}真的{/i}。我只是……重置结束后就有这种感觉。虽然我知道这算不上什么能追的线索——

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy34
: No, it’s a good place to start. And it gives us more of a reason to implement her in some of our experiments going forward.
lines.zh: : 不，这是个不错的起点。而且这让我们更有理由在今后的一些实验里把她加进来。

lines.en: : Experiments?
lines.zh: : 实验?

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy33
: What we were talking about during the beach meeting before everything collapsed again.
lines.zh: : 就是上次一切又崩塌之前，我们在海滩那次会上谈的东西。

lines.en: : You don’t remember that, do you?
lines.zh: : 那个你不记得了吧?

lines.en: : It’s...{i}kind of{/i} there. But yeah, none of the details came with me.
lines.zh: : 那个……{i}有点{/i}印象。不过细节全都没跟过来。

lines.en: : Well, the gist was that we run a series of tests to try and push the boundaries of the world. And I wanted to incorporate Maya since she’d been so relevant in the past.
lines.zh: : 大意就是，我们做一系列测试，试着去推这个世界的边界。而我想把 Maya 也拉进来，毕竟她以前一直很关键。

lines.en: : To think this would somehow be her {i}fault{/i} though, just...doesn’t make much sense to me at the moment. But it’s something we can explore going forward.
lines.zh: : 不过要说这会是她的{i}错{/i}，眼下我实在想不通。但这是我们将来可以去探究的方向。

lines.en: : And how do you propose we do that? Starting right now.
lines.zh: : 那你打算怎么做？就从现在开始。

lines.en: : {i}Right now,{/i} I’m more concerned about the fact that national holidays are suddenly being affected by the loops. That’s never happened before, has it?
lines.zh: : {i}现在{/i}，我更担心的是法定节日居然开始受循环影响了。这种事以前从没发生过吧?

lines.en: : Not to my knowledge, no. So who {i}knows{/i} what else could have changed this time?
lines.zh: : 据我所知没有。所以谁{i}知道{/i}这次还有什么别的东西变了?

lines.en: : Well, what do you suggest we do in order to find out? Act normal and slowly uncover any differences? Or maybe {i}crash{/i} out like I was doing until you got here?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得我们该怎么查？装作正常，慢慢找出所有不同？还是像你来之前我那样{i}崩溃{/i}一场?

lines.en: : Let me talk to Ayane a little more. We’ll try to find a way that all three of us can get together and- wait. Have you heard from Yumi at all? She was at the party too, wasn’t she?
lines.zh: : 我先跟 Ayane 多聊聊。我们会想办法让我们三个凑到一起——等等。你有 Yumi 的消息吗？她也在派对上吧?

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy35
: I haven’t had time to check my phone, but I imagine she’ll be here soon enough seeing as there’s free food.
lines.zh: : 我还没时间看手机，不过我想她很快就会来，毕竟这儿有免费的食物。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s a safe bet. Talk to her when she gets here, okay? That’s the mission I’m giving you.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这个赌注很稳。她来了你就跟她谈谈，好吗？这就是我交给你的任务。

lines.en: : Sure, but...
lines.zh: : 好，不过……

lines.en: : But what?
lines.zh: : 不过什么?

lines.en: : It’s just...
lines.zh: : 只是……

lines.en: : Aren’t you acting a little more responsible and proactive than normal right now?
lines.zh: : 你现在是不是比平时更负责任、更主动了一点?

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy36
: You’re just normally so lackadaisical when it comes to all of this stuff that having you drag me aside out of nowhere to hear my thoughts and delegate responsibilities is, like...
lines.zh: : 你平时在这些事上一向懒懒散散的，现在却突然把我拉到一边，听我的想法、还分配任务，这感觉……

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy37
: {i}Kind of{/i} hot...
lines.zh: : {i}还挺{/i}性感的……

lines.en: : Makoto. Really?
lines.zh: : Makoto。真的假的?

lines.en: : What? I like authority and it feels like you’re actually in charge right now. Sue me.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？我就吃权威这一套，而且现在感觉你真的在掌权。有本事告我啊。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy38
: Keep it in your pants. We need to- Makoto. Stop blushing.
lines.zh: : 收敛点。我们还得——Makoto。别脸红了。

lines.en: : The stricter you are with me, the hornier I will become. I am not proud, but this is who I am.
lines.zh: : 你对我越严厉，我就越兴奋。我不觉得这值得骄傲，但我就是这样的人。

lines.en: : Just keep an eye out for Yumi, okay? And don’t go back out there until your face is less red.
lines.zh: : 你就帮我留意 Yumi，好吗？还有，等脸没那么红了再出去。

lines.en: scene makotoxmasangy39
: Can you at least {i}grope{/i} me or something so I can calm down?
lines.zh: : 你至少{i}摸{/i}我一下什么的，让我冷静下来行吗?

lines.en: : No. I have things to figure out right now.
lines.zh: : 不行。我现在有事情要想清楚。

lines.en: scene black
: Oi! What’s going on in- oh, Senpai. You’re already out. Then what was that noise I just-
lines.zh: : 喂!里面怎么回事——哦，Senpai。你已经出来了。那刚才那声是什么——

lines.en: : Yeah, Makoto’s acting weird. Also, I couldn’t convince her Christmalloween is a real holiday that we all celebrate every year. Ayane, where are you?
lines.zh: : 嗯，Makoto 有点不对劲。还有，我没能说服她圣诞万圣节是个我们每年都过的真节日。Ayane，你在哪儿?

lines.en: : H-Here! Hello!
lines.zh: : 在、在这儿!你好!

lines.en: : Wait! Sensei! Uhh...if you have a minute-
lines.zh: : 等等!Sensei!呃……如果你有空——

lines.en: : It’s going to have to wait, Kirin. Sorry. Ayane, come on. Let’s talk more outside.
lines.zh: : 得等等了，Kirin。抱歉。Ayane，走吧。我们出去再说。

lines.en: : Coming!
lines.zh: : 来了!

lines.en: : That’s fine...
lines.zh: : 没关系……

lines.en: : I just have to wait a little while...
lines.zh: : 我只要再等一会儿就好了……

lines.en: {i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}
